name: Anthropic
statusNote: Still private as of 2026-10-21; it has NOT listed and has NOT publicly filed. No public S-1 on EDGAR as of the morning of 2026-10-21. Yahoo Finance (three sources, 2026-10-21) says the public S-1 could come as soon as Friday 2026-10-23; IFR says filing on 2026-10-26, roadshow from 2026-11-09 and pricing the following week, raising up to $100B at ~$2T. Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs are joint bookrunners.

latestValuationSignal.note: IPO target valuation (IFR, WSJ via EngineerPal). Reuters reports some investors are weighing ~$1.5T, and Bloomberg reports a cohort of investors urged Anthropic to lower its IPO valuation target (https://engineerpal.com/anthropic-ipo-s1-filing/; https://www.msn.com/en-us/money/companies/nvidia-backed-nscale-anthropic-in-talks-for-new-45-billion-ai-cloud-deal-source-says/ar-AA2fBi5x).

changes: Investor day (2026-10-14): Q3 2026 revenue was $16.8B, up 45% from $11.6B in Q2 (Q1 $4.7B). Anthropic said it was profitable on an adjusted basis and cash-flow positive in Q3 (FT, Bloomberg, CNBC, Reuters) (https://www.ft.com/content/11632d03-358c-454b-af95-d06d4072932b; https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-14/anthropic-revenue-jumps-to-16-8-billion-in-quarter-before-ipo; https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/15/anthropics-third-quarter-revenue-hits-16point8-billion-ipo.html)

WSJ/Reuters (2026-10-20), from the confidential draft S-1: H1 2026 revenue was $16.3B and the net loss $80.7B, of which ~$72B is a non-cash charge on convertible bonds (https://engineerpal.com/anthropic-ipo-s1-filing/)

IPO timing: public S-1 expected as soon as 2026-10-23 (Yahoo Finance) or on 2026-10-26 (IFR), roadshow from 2026-11-09, mid-November listing targeting up to $100B raised at ~$2T. Reuters earlier said the debut was likely after the US midterms. Not yet filed or listed (https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/article/anthropic-to-publicly-file-for-ipo-as-early-as-friday-sources-say-135343841.html; https://www.ifre.com/equities/2499407/anthropic-pushes-ahead-with-mid-november-ipo)

2026-10-18: Anthropic announced a Public Benefit Fund (wholly owned LLC) that will hold 5% of its shares, subject to stockholder approval, plus 2% more per 50% rise in value above a baseline (https://www.anthropic.com/news/public-benefit-fund)

Bloomberg/Reuters/CNBC (2026-10-19/20): in talks with Nscale for a second ~$45B, 460MW compute lease at the Monarch campus in West Virginia, on top of the $45B deal from August (https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/20/anthropic-nscale-data-center-deal.html)
notes: The arr value of $67.2B is DERIVED (Q3 2026 quarterly revenue of $16.8B x 4), not a figure Anthropic quoted. The last directly reported run-rate is >$65B at end-July (Reuters). WSJ reports investors expect ~$110B annualized revenue by year-end (projection, not used). Anthropic and OpenAI dispute gross vs net revenue accounting. No X posts verified.
